physicalNotes: Radius 0.545 Jupiter radii from Sanchis-Ojeda et al. 2013 (2013ApJ...775...54S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...775...54S/abstract): 38,963.1 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Sanchis-Ojeda et al. 2013 (2013ApJ...775...54S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...775...54S/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.378 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
